# Architecture Decision Record Format

Store accepted decisions under `docs/adr/` using the next available number and
a short dash-case title, for example `0007-keep-order-validation-local.md`.

```md
# ADR-0007: Keep order validation local

## Status

Accepted

## Context

What decision was needed, including the load-bearing constraints.

## Decision

What was chosen and why.

## Consequences

What becomes easier, what becomes harder, and which alternatives are ruled out.
```

Record durable architectural reasons, not temporary scheduling or priority
decisions.
